verses.text: Now accept the one who is weak in faith, [but] not for [the purpose of] passing judgment on his opinions.
verses.textZh: 信心軟弱的，你們要接納，但不要辯論所疑惑的事。

verses.text: One person has faith that he may eat all things, but he who is weak eats vegetables [only].
verses.textZh: 有人信百物都可吃；但那軟弱的，只吃蔬菜。

verses.text: The one who eats is not to regard with contempt the one who does not eat, and the one who does not eat is not to judge the one who eats, for God has accepted him.
verses.textZh: 吃的人不可輕看不吃的人；不吃的人不可論斷吃的人；因為神已經收納他了。

verses.text: Who are you to judge the servant of another? To his own master he stands or falls; and he will stand, for the Lord is able to make him stand.
verses.textZh: 你是誰，竟論斷別人的僕人呢？他或站住，或跌倒，自有他的主人在；而且他也必要站住，因為主能使他站住。

verses.text: One person regards one day above another, another regards every day [alike]. Each person must be fully convinced in his own mind.
verses.textZh: 有人看這日比那日強；有人看日日都是一樣。只是各人心裡要意見堅定。

verses.text: He who observes the day, observes it for the Lord, and he who eats, does so for the Lord, for he gives thanks to God; and he who eats not, for the Lord he does not eat, and gives thanks to God.
verses.textZh: 守日的人是為主守的；吃的人是為主吃的，因他感謝神；不吃的人是為主不吃的，也感謝神。

verses.text: For not one of us lives for himself, and not one dies for himself;
verses.textZh: 我們沒有一個人為自己活，也沒有一個人為自己死。

verses.text: for if we live, we live for the Lord, or if we die, we die for the Lord; therefore whether we live or die, we are the Lord's.
verses.textZh: 我們若活著，是為主而活；若死了，是為主而死。所以，我們或活或死總是主的人。

verses.text: For to this end Christ died and lived again, that He might be Lord both of the dead and of the living.
verses.textZh: 因此基督死了又活了，為要作死人並活人的主。

verses.text: But you, why do you judge your brother? Or you again, why do you regard your brother with contempt? For we will all stand before the judgment seat of God.
verses.textZh: 你這個人，為甚麼論斷弟兄呢？又為甚麼輕看弟兄呢？因我們都要站在神的臺前。

verses.text: For it is written, 'AS I LIVE, SAYS THE LORD, EVERY KNEE SHALL BOW TO ME, AND EVERY TONGUE SHALL GIVE PRAISE TO GOD.'
verses.textZh: 經上寫著：主說：我憑著我的永生起誓：萬膝必向我跪拜；萬口必向我承認。

verses.text: So then each one of us will give an account of himself to God.
verses.textZh: 這樣看來，我們各人必要將自己的事在神面前說明。

verses.text: Therefore let us not judge one another anymore, but rather determine this-- not to put an obstacle or a stumbling block in a brother's way.
verses.textZh: 所以，我們不可再彼此論斷，寧可定意誰也不給弟兄放下絆腳跌人之物。

verses.text: I know and am convinced in the Lord Jesus that nothing is unclean in itself; but to him who thinks anything to be unclean, to him it is unclean.
verses.textZh: 我憑著主耶穌確知深信，凡物本來沒有不潔淨的；惟獨人以為不潔淨的，在他就不潔淨了。

verses.text: For if because of food your brother is hurt, you are no longer walking according to love. Do not destroy with your food him for whom Christ died.
verses.textZh: 你若因食物叫弟兄憂愁，就不是按著愛人的道理行。基督已經替他死，你不可因你的食物叫他敗壞。

verses.text: Therefore do not let what is for you a good thing be spoken of as evil;
verses.textZh: 不可叫你的善被人毀謗；

verses.text: for the kingdom of God is not eating and drinking, but righteousness and peace and joy in the Holy Spirit.
verses.textZh: 因為神的國不在乎吃喝，只在乎公義、和平，並聖靈中的喜樂。

verses.text: For he who in this [way] serves Christ is acceptable to God and approved by men.
verses.textZh: 在這幾樣上服事基督的，就為神所喜悅，又為人所稱許。

verses.text: So then we pursue the things which make for peace and the building up of one another.
verses.textZh: 所以，我們務要追求和睦的事與彼此建立德行的事。

verses.text: Do not tear down the work of God for the sake of food. All things indeed are clean, but they are evil for the man who eats and gives offense.
verses.textZh: 不可因食物毀壞神的工程。凡物固然潔淨，但有人因食物叫人跌倒，就是他的罪了。

verses.text: It is good not to eat meat or to drink wine, or [to do anything] by which your brother stumbles.
verses.textZh: 無論是吃肉，是喝酒，是甚麼別的事，叫弟兄跌倒，一概不做才好。

verses.text: The faith which you have, have as your own conviction before God. Happy is he who does not condemn himself in what he approves.
verses.textZh: 你有信心，就當在神面前守著。人在自己以為可行的事上能不自責，就有福了。

verses.text: But he who doubts is condemned if he eats, because [his eating is] not from faith; and whatever is not from faith is sin.
verses.textZh: 若有疑心而吃的，就必有罪，因為他吃不是出於信心。凡不出於信心的都是罪。
